candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) from inventory, causing 503 on /v1/reservations, transport ReadTimeouts on order->inventory, and 502s on /v1/orders and /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs admitted; root cause of the redis timeout (saturation vs network) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502s on /v1/checkout; topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2406ms) and 502s. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/saturation metrics to confirm the timeout origin
